title: 第594章 雪猎第597章 得图
content_zh:
许星遥一步一步，在深可及膝的积雪中跋涉。
每一步落下，都伴随着积雪压实的声音，以及骨骼关节因寒冷和僵硬而发出的细微“咯吱”声。他的动作极为缓慢，如同一个背负着千钧重担的年迈老人，在泥沼中挣扎前行。
体表那层淡蓝色的护体灵光，已经微弱到几乎看不见。更多夹杂着煞意玄冰寒气，毫无阻碍地穿透这层薄弱防御，疯狂涌入他的体内。
许星遥能清晰地感受到，除了灵力在那煞气的磨砺下，被一丝丝淬炼得更加精纯凝练，自己的经脉、血肉、骨骼，在这无孔不入的极端寒意侵蚀下，也在被动地、极其缓慢地得到强化。
“值得……太值得了……”
许星遥心中默念，青白色的脸上甚至努力挤出了一丝难以察觉的笑意。他甘愿忍受这凌迟般的痛苦，甘愿将前进的速度放慢到如同龟爬，甘愿让自己看起来像个在秘境寒风中随时可能倒毙的弱者。
是的，弱者。并非许星遥刻意扮演，而是在外人看来，此刻蹒跚独行于暴风雪中的他，气息微弱且紊乱不堪，步履虚浮艰难，体表灵光暗淡近乎于无，浑身挂满厚厚的冰霜，须发皆白，活脱脱就是一个在秘境中艰难求存的玄根初期倒霉修士，而且看其不稳的灵力波动，恐怕初入玄根境都未必稳固，正是最完美的猎物。
时间，在这缓慢而痛苦、却又带着隐秘收获的跋涉中流逝。许星遥又翻过一道被冰雪覆盖的低矮山脊，前方是一片没有边际的冰原，狂风卷着鹅毛大雪，形成一片白茫茫的雪幕，看不清远处具体情形。
就在他深一脚浅一脚地踏入这片冰原不久，神念边缘，忽然传来一丝微弱的灵力波动。
有人，而且刻意收敛了气息！
许星遥心中微凛，但脚步没有丝毫停顿，依旧保持着那副“虚弱不堪”、“步履维艰”的模样。他甚至故意让原本就紊乱的气息又“无力”地波动了半分，体表那层微弱的护体灵光也随之闪烁了一下，仿佛随时要溃散。他深深地低着头，目光似乎只聚焦于脚下那仿佛永无止境的艰难雪路，对身侧的窥探“毫无所觉”。
在一根庞大的冰柱后面，一双充满贪婪的眼睛，正死死盯着风雪中那个仿佛随时会被吞没的身影。
这是一个身形瘦高、脸颊凹陷的中年男子，身穿与冰雪环境颇为接近的灰白色劲装，手中握着一柄略带弧度的银色短刃。他修为在玄根四层，气息不算特别强横，但眼神锐利，透着股常年刀头舔血的狠辣与油滑。他进入玄冰寒渊后运气一般，只找到了几株不值钱的二阶寒属性草药，正愁没有大收获，就远远瞥见了这个在暴风雪中艰难独行的“肥羊”。
“玄根初期，灵力波动紊乱，几近枯竭……独行……身上说不定有点好东西……”
中年男子舔了舔有些干裂的嘴唇，眼中贪婪之色几乎要溢出来，心脏因兴奋而微微加速跳动。在玄冰寒渊这种不论生死的秘境之地，杀人夺宝是再正常不过的事情。尤其对方状态如此之差，简直是天赐良机，不容错过。
至于对方是否真的毫无还手之力？中年男子并非毫无戒心，他暗中观察了对方好一会儿，确认对方步履虚浮深重，气息极不稳定，时断时续，周身灵力波动微弱到几乎可以忽略不计，连行走都如此艰难，绝不似伪装。而且，对方似乎心神俱疲，连最基本的神念警戒都松懈到了极点，这更让他确信了自己的判断。
“合该老子走运！”
中年男子心中狞笑，最后一丝疑虑也被贪婪压下。他不再犹豫，身形从冰柱后滑出，紧贴着起伏的雪面，借助风雪的掩护，悄无声息地向着许星遥身后绕行而去！他打定主意，靠近到最佳距离，暴起发难，一击必杀，绝不给对方任何反应的机会。
两百丈、一百五十丈、一百丈……
距离在迅速拉近。风雪呼啸，很好地掩盖了他细微的破空声。

五十丈、三十丈……中年男子已经能清晰地看到许星遥背影上凝结的厚重冰霜，以及那仿佛下一刻就要扑倒在雪地里的姿态。
十丈！就是现在！
中年男子眼中凶光爆射，不再掩饰杀意，体内灵力毫无保留地注入手中银色短刃！短刃发出一声轻微的嗡鸣，刃身泛起一层幽绿色的诡异光芒，显然淬有剧毒。他脚下在雪地中猛地一蹬，炸开一团雪雾，速度暴涨，化作一道模糊的灰影，手中毒刃划破风雪，直刺许星遥后心！
然而，就在那短刃即将及体的一刹那，前方那“毫无所觉”的虚弱身影，动了！
许星遥如同背后长了眼睛一般，在间不容发之际，以一种与其之前蹒跚姿态完全不符的轻描淡写，向左侧横移了半步。泛着幽光的淬毒短刃，带着刺骨的寒意和致命的锋锐，擦着他的右臂外侧划过，凌厉的劲风将他的衣衫割开一道口子，却连他手臂的油皮都没能蹭破。
中年男子志在必得的一击落空，心中警铃大作，一股寒意从脚底板直冲天灵盖，比这玄冰寒渊的寒风还要冰冷刺骨！不好！中计了！这家伙是装的！
他反应不可谓不快，一击不中，毫不恋战，脚下猛地一蹬雪地，身形就要向后暴退，同时左手已经掐诀，准备施展遁术。
但，许星遥比他更快！
在横移半步避开致命一击的同时，许星遥那一直低垂的头颅猛然抬起，一直“涣散”的眼眸中，骤然爆发出冰冷刺骨的寒光。周身那微弱到近乎熄灭的护体灵光瞬间暴涨。
玄根六层的灵力波动毫无保留地释放开来，虽然因为之前淬炼消耗而并非全盛状态，但那股带着凛冽寒意的灵压，如同无形的冰潮海啸，轰然席卷向近在咫尺的偷袭者！
“玄根……六层？怎么可能！”中年男子瞳孔骤缩，脸上写满了惊骇与难以置信。这哪里是什么灵力枯竭的玄根初期弱者？这分明是一个修为比自己还高的狠角色！
他心中的恐惧瞬间压倒了贪念，只想立刻远遁，但许星遥又岂会给他逃走的机会？
“凝！”
content_en:
Xu Xingyuan walked step by step through the knee-deep snow.
Every step fell, accompanied by the sound of snow compacting, as well as the slight "creaking" sound of bones and joints due to cold and stiffness. His movements were extremely slow, like an old man struggling to move forward in the mire with a heavy burden on his back.
The light blue protective aura on the body's surface was so weak that it was almost invisible. More black ice-cold energy mixed with evil intent penetrated this weak defense without any hindrance and poured into his body crazily.
Xu Xingyao could clearly feel that in addition to his spiritual power being refined and refined by bits and pieces under the temper of the evil spirit, his own meridians, flesh and blood, and bones were also being passively and extremely slowly strengthened under the erosion of this all-pervasive extreme cold.
"It's worth it...it's so worth it..."
Xu Xingyao thought silently in his heart, and even managed to squeeze out an imperceptible smile on his blue-white face. He was willing to endure the painful pain, to slow down his progress to a turtle crawling, and to look like a weakling who might die at any time in the cold wind of the secret realm.
Yes, weak. It's not that Xu Xingyao deliberately acted, but to outsiders, he was stumbling alone in the blizzard at this moment. His breath was weak and disordered, his steps were hollow and difficult, his body was dim and almost non-existent, his body was covered with thick frost, and his beard and hair were all white. He looked like an unlucky monk in the early stage of the Mysterious Root struggling to survive in the secret realm. And judging from his unstable spiritual power fluctuations, he might not be stable even when he first entered the Mysterious Root realm, so he was the perfect prey.
Time passes in this slow and painful journey, but with hidden gains. Xu Xingyao climbed over another low ridge covered with ice and snow. In front of him was an endless ice field. The strong wind rolled up the heavy snow, forming a vast white snow curtain, making it difficult to see the specific situation in the distance.
Not long after he stepped deeply into the ice field, a faint fluctuation of spiritual power suddenly came from the edge of his spiritual thoughts.
There was someone, and he deliberately restrained his breath!
Xu Xingyao's heart was slightly shuddered, but his steps did not stop at all, and he still maintained that "weak" and "difficult" appearance. He even deliberately let the originally chaotic aura fluctuate "powerlessly" for another half minute, and the weak protective spiritual light on the surface of his body also flickered, as if it was about to collapse at any time. He lowered his head deeply, his eyes seemed to be focused only on the seemingly endless difficult snowy road under his feet, and he was "oblivious" to the prying eyes on his side.
Behind a huge icicle, a pair of greedy eyes were staring at the figure in the snow that seemed to be swallowed up at any time.
This is a middle-aged man with a tall and thin body and sunken cheeks. He is wearing a gray-white outfit that is quite close to the ice and snow environment. He is holding a slightly curved silver short blade in his hand. His cultivation level is at the fourth level of Xuangen. His aura is not particularly strong, but his eyes are sharp, showing the ruthlessness and slickness of a knife that has been licking blood all year round. After entering the Black Ice Cold Abyss, he had no luck and only found a few worthless second-level cold-attributed herbs. When he was worried that he would not gain much, he caught a glimpse of this "fat sheep" walking alone in the snowstorm from a distance.
"In the early stage of Xuan Gen, the spiritual power fluctuates in disorder and is almost exhausted... walking alone... maybe there is something good in me..."
The middle-aged man licked his chapped lips, the greed in his eyes almost overflowing, and his heart beating slightly faster due to excitement. In a secret place like Xuan Bing Han Abyss, where life and death matter, killing people and seizing treasures is a normal thing. Especially when the other party is in such poor condition, it is simply a God-given opportunity that cannot be missed.
As for whether the other party is really powerless to fight back? The middle-aged man was not unsuspecting. He secretly observed the other person for a while and confirmed that the other person's steps were heavy and heavy, his breath was extremely unstable and intermittent, and the fluctuations in his spiritual power were so weak that they were almost negligible. Even walking was so difficult, it was definitely not like he was pretending. Moreover, the other party seemsHe was so exhausted that even the most basic spiritual vigilance was relaxed to the extreme, which made him even more convinced of his judgment.
"Thank you for your luck!"
The middle-aged man smiled ferociously in his heart, and his last trace of doubt was suppressed by greed. He no longer hesitated, and slid out from behind the icicle, clinging to the undulating snow surface, using the cover of wind and snow to quietly circle behind Xu Xingyao! He made up his mind, got close to the optimal distance, launched an attack, and killed with one strike, never giving the opponent any chance to react.
Two hundred feet, one hundred and fifty feet, one hundred feet...
The distance is closing rapidly. The howling wind and snow covered up his subtle sound of breaking through the air well.
Fifty feet, thirty feet... The middle-aged man could clearly see the thick frost condensed on Xu Xingyao's back, as well as his posture as if he was about to fall into the snow the next moment.
Ten feet! That's it now!
The middle-aged man's eyes flashed fiercely, and he no longer concealed his murderous intent. The spiritual power in his body was poured into the silver short blade in his hand without any reservation! The short blade made a slight buzzing sound, and the blade glowed with a strange green light, which was obviously quenched with poison. He kicked hard in the snow, exploding a cloud of snow mist, his speed increased dramatically, and turned into a blurry gray shadow. The poisonous blade in his hand cut through the wind and snow, piercing Xu Xingyao's back heart!
However, at the moment when the short blade was about to reach his body, the "unconscious" weak figure in front of him moved!
As if there were eyes on his back, Xu Xingyao took half a step to the left in an understatement that was completely inconsistent with his previous staggering posture. The gleaming poison-tempered short blade, with biting coldness and deadly sharpness, scraped across the outside of his right arm. The fierce wind cut a gash in his clothes, but it couldn't even break the oily skin of his arm.
The middle-aged man's determined blow failed, and the alarm bells rang in his heart. A chill rushed from the soles of his feet to the sky, which was even colder and biting than the cold wind of the Xuanbing Abyss! not good! Fell into a trap! This guy is just faking it!
His reaction was not unpleasant. He missed every blow and showed no signs of fighting. He kicked off the snow with his feet and was about to retreat backwards. At the same time, his left hand had already made a seal, preparing to use the escape technique.
However, Xu Xingyao is faster than him!
While moving half a step sideways to avoid the fatal blow, Xu Xingyao's head that had been lowered suddenly raised, and a piercing cold light suddenly erupted in his eyes that had been "distracted". The body-protecting aura around him that was so weak that it was almost extinguished suddenly surged.
The spiritual power fluctuations of the sixth level of the Mysterious Root were released without reservation. Although it was not in full strength due to previous tempering and consumption, the cold spiritual pressure was like an invisible icy tsunami, sweeping toward the approaching sneak attacker!
"Xuangen...sixth level? How is that possible!" The middle-aged man's pupils shrank suddenly, his face full of horror and disbelief. Where is this weak person in the early stage of mystical roots who has exhausted his spiritual power? This is clearly a ruthless character whose cultivation level is higher than his own!
The fear in his heart instantly overwhelmed his greed, and he just wanted to run away immediately, but how could Xu Xingyao give him a chance to escape?
"Condensation!"
